description: Maxwell convicted as Epstein's primary operational partner in sex trafficking ring. ~400 documented flight legs together.
Wexner granted Epstein sweeping power of attorney in 1991 and transferred approximately $1 billion in assets. The foundational relationship of Epstein's wealth.
Kellen granted immunity as named co-conspirator. 364 documented flight legs. Scheduled abuse sessions with minors.
Groff served as Epstein's executive assistant, the second most-mentioned person in the DOJ release with 157,613 references. Immunity grantee.
Epstein's primary attorney and estate executor. Named in the 1953 Trust will.
Dershowitz served as Epstein's defense attorney during the 2006-2008 NPA negotiations. Later subject of allegations by Virginia Giuffre.
Clinton took 26 documented flight legs on Epstein's aircraft. Maxwell's initials appear on each leg.
Documented social relationship from late 1980s through early 2000s. Epstein expelled from Mar-a-Lago in 2007. 38,000+ references in DOJ files.
Barak had 4,000+ references in DOJ files. The apartment at 301 E 66th St was referred to internally as 'Ehud's apartment'. Intelligence connections alleged.
Maxwell and Kellen flew together approximately 39 times in 2003 alone. Both convicted or immunity-granted as operational partners.
Brunel founded MC2 Model Management which served as a recruitment pipeline for Epstein. 4,727 references in DOJ files.
Acosta, as US Attorney in Florida, negotiated and signed the 2007 NPA granting Epstein and unnamed co-conspirators immunity.
Black paid Epstein approximately $158 million in advisory fees, according to an independent investigation. Resigned as Apollo CEO following disclosure.
Staley maintained documented relationship with Epstein through JPMorgan. Appears in scheduling emails coordinated by Groff.
Palm Beach police records state Epstein told a victim he had purchased Marcinkova from her family to be his 'sex slave'. She was later an immunity grantee.
